name: E420Z stock row
description: Adds a native E420Z row to the stock goggles sidebar. Opening it opens the stock Settings-style content panel beside the sidebar (Safety / Control / Camera / Display / About). No overlay window, no input hooks, no frame compositing.
notes: The stock UI renderer, focus and input are reused unchanged. If the menu ever misbehaves, use Recover stock UI or reboot; /vendor/libew_gls.so is not modified.
